hmm3.scope: Exact equivalence for the published fitted HMM distribution, not exact fit to raw data; Only feasible=true grid points are accepted as probability models. Infeasible points retain diagnostic minima/errors, not latent-change estimates. No proof of entire-interval feasibility or global optimality.
